'''Pekt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] from [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]] who was born into a powerful family, and became a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he joined with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Hindane Darcc]] to enslave the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. He and Darcc were subsequently [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|chased]] off Kashyyyk by a Wookiee [[Army/Legends|army]] led by the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Pekt was then killed in the raid on [[Avatar Orbital Platform]].

==Biography==
===Early career===
{{Quote|This is but a minor sssssetback. We will ssssssee you again. The price of Wookiee pelts isn't getting any lower.|Pekt during his escape from the Trade Federation fortress on Alaris Prime|audio=PektEscape.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] Pekt was born on the [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. He was a member of a powerful [[Pekt's clan|clan]], and at a young age, began to expand his clan's empire. As a young hatchling, he used his servants in experiments with [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] restraints. After reaching the molt stage, Pekt moved on to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] prisoners-of-war kept in his clan's [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] and soon gained a reputation for his sadism.<ref name="SW:GB DataBank" />

Realizing that the Wookiees had great strength, Pekt used his [[Pekt's father|father's]] fortune to research their biology, and developed a series of techniques to capture and enslave them. He earned a certain degree of fame when he was consulted by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] in order to make some custom weapons for him, and in return, Pekt received a number of fine Wookiee pelts, which he gifted to his egg-litter. On one job, a [[Unidentified Wookiee (Pekt)|Wookiee]] broke free, seized Pekt in his paws, and tore off the Trandoshan's [[Limb/Legends|arms]] while Pekt just stared at him. The Wookiee was then [[Death/Legends|killed]] and Pekt returned to Trandosha. Within a [[Standard month/Legends|month]], his arms had regenerated, a trait shared by all Trandoshans, and he was back at the camp.<ref name="SW:GB DataBank" />

[[File:Pekt_ships.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Pekt escaped the destruction of the Trade Federation fortress on Alaris Prime.]]
Sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] &mdash;which Pekt participated in as described in as portrayed in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''&mdash;between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].</ref> Pekt was an ally of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] during their [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|illegal]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonization]] of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]] in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]]. When the rightful Wookiee [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] first landed there they encountered and destroyed a Trade Federation [[Power core/Legends|power core]], which had been previously damaged by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]] living on the moon. A [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] named [[OOL-2]] found the remains of the power core and identified the gundarks as the perpetrators to [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]], who ordered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to exterminate the gundarks, skin them, and bring their pelts to the Trandoshans.<ref name="SW:GB" />

The Wookiees and the Trade Federation encountered each other when they both [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|attacked]] the [[Unidentified gundark nest|gundark nest]]. The Trade Federation attacked the Wookiees, leading to several [[Alaris Prime colonial war|conflicts]] on the moon which saw the destruction of several Trade Federation installations before the Wookiee leader [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] planned a final attack on their last [[Unidentified Trade Federation base|base]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] arrived to participate in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]], sighting several of Pekt's [[Neimoidian transport|transport ships]] and correctly deducing that they belonged to Trandoshan slavers. The Wookiee objective in the battle was to destroy the Trade Federation [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]],<ref name="SW:GB" /> which they achieved using [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]].<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> Jinn alerted the Wookiees that two of Pekt's [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]] flew from the wreckage, inside one of them the Trandoshan claimed the Wookiee victory was only a minor setback and that he would return as Wookiee pelts were still valuable.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Enslavement of the Wookiees===
{{Quote|No sign of Darcc. I'll wager that's him and Pekt in that transport.|Solo, upon sighting Darcc's shuttle leaving the planet|audio=NoSignOfDarcc.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[File:DarccPektEscape1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darcc and Pekt escape Kashyyyk with a cargo hold full of Wookiees.]]
Gradually, Pekt's reputation as a Wookiee-exterminator garnered him several jobs around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], working for bounty hunters, gangsters, and eventually the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He hired a task force of ex-[[Trandoshan Army]] regulars and it was rumored that he could clear a Wookiee village in less than a [[Standard week/Legends|standard week]].<ref name="SW:GB DataBank" />

When the Empire took control of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], under advisement from Trandosha, they enslaved the major [[City/Legends|cities]] of the planet. Pekt and the Trandoshan [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] were selected by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Hindane Darcc]] to oversee the entire slaving operation, and Pekt drew up the plans for the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]], a slaving hub in Kashyyyk's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Pekt knew as long as the Empire controlled Kashyyyk, he could act with impunity, and he did&mdash;stepping up both his experiments and his slaving trade.<ref name="SW:GB DataBank" />

However, in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the enslaved Wookiees, [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|freed and gathered]] by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] members [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], attacked Pekt and Darcc's holdings. After the Wookiee [[Army/Legends|army]] destroyed [[Darcc's Palace]], Pekt and the Moff escaped in a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], with a hold full of Wookiee slaves, to the heavily protected Avatar Orbital Platform. There they stood in the station's [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. The Wookiee army followed them to Avatar and knocked out the station's [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]]s, preventing their escape. With the arrival of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], their fortress was demolished. Solo and Pekt traded insults, and Pekt and Darcc were soon [[Death/Legends|killed]],<ref name="SW:GB" /> one of the most important supportive acts for the [[Kashyyyk resistance/Legends|Kashyyyk Resistance]].<ref name="Intrigue">''[[Galaxy of Intrigue]]''</ref> The orbital station was destroyed soon afterwards.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:PektSprite-SWGB.png|thumb|Pekt]]
{{Quote|Man, you Trandoshans are ugly up close.''"<br />"''The sentiment is mutual, human.|Han Solo and Pekt trading insults on Avatar Orbital Station|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
At an early age, Pekt experimented with slavery restraints. When a Wookiee was trying to tear his arms off, he just stared back coldly. Pekt, like Trandoshans in general, was not considered to be honest or brave.<ref name="SW:GB DataBank" /> At the time of his death, he had such a reputation for brutality and sadism that even other Trandoshans feared him. Pekt also considered [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to be ugly.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pekt was voiced by [[Frank Welker]] in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. He received his first [[canon]]ical mention in the game's [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], and went on to appear in the game's Chewbacca campaign. He and Darcc escape in a scripted event at the end of the fifth mission. In the sixth mission, taking place on Avatar, the player's objective is to kill Pekt and Darcc.
